tt_experimental_note: TikTok support is experimental. It uses TikTok's Login Kit and Display API with your own TikTok developer app: profile stats and public videos with views, likes, comments and shares. Reach, watch time, demographics and comments are not available.
tt_derived_note: TikTok has no daily statistics for third-party apps. Daily views and new followers are estimated from the differences between syncs, so sync at least once a day for accuracy.
tt_sandbox_note: Sandbox app: only the target users added in TikTok for Developers (up to 10) can connect.
tt_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect @{u} from MetaDash? The access is revoked at TikTok.
tt_delete_data_confirm: Also delete the data MetaDash stored for this account (videos, snapshots, daily series)? Cancel keeps the history.
tt_connect_hint: Your browser opens TikTok; after you approve, it returns to MetaDash on this computer (127.0.0.1). Repeat for each account. If that does not work, use the paste-code sign-in.
tt_paste_hint: After approving in TikTok, the callback page shows a code. Copy the code (or the whole page address) and paste it here.
tt_client_hint: Create an app in TikTok for Developers with Login Kit (Desktop) and the scopes user.info.basic, user.info.profile, user.info.stats and video.list, then paste its client key and client secret.
tt_paste_redirect: Paste-code callback page (https, optional; must also be registered in your app)
